scenarios.scenarioLabel: Happy Path: N2 - Presale access

scenarios.scenarioLabel: Happy Path: N3 - Ticket transfer
scenarios.description: A ticket holder initiates a transfer to another person. The recipient is notified, verifies their identity, and accepts the transfer. A new barcode is generated and the original is revoked.

scenarios.scenarioLabel: Happy Path: N4 - Event cancellation
scenarios.description: An event is cancelled by the organizer. All tickets are revoked, all payments are refunded, and all affected customers are notified. Demonstrates cascading cross-context side effects from a single domain event.
